name: Officier Shearsmith
source:
Shearsmith is a bitter and weary officer who has served in the policde for many years. Ever since losing his/her old partner and best friend, Steve 'Pembo' Pemberton, things haven't been the same.
A good officer at heart, Shearsmith struggles to warm to his new partner while still stuck in the past.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/thegraveyardshift]Itch.io[/url]]
